ValidationRule.description: Enter the VAT number in the correct format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && $Setup.ER_Validation_Rules_Settings__c.VRBE03_Valid_VATnr__c = false && ISPICKVAL(ER_BUPicklist__c, 'BENELUX') && RecordType.DeveloperName != 'ER_Competitor' && NOT(ISBLANK(ER_VAT_Number__c)) && ( (IF( LEFT(ER_VAT_Number__c, 2) = 'BE', NOT(REGEX(ER_VAT_Number__c, "BE[0-1]{1}[0-9]{9}")), FALSE)) || (IF(LEFT(ER_VAT_Number__c, 2) = 'LU', NOT(REGEX(ER_VAT_Number__c, "LU[0-9]{8}")) || MOD(VALUE(LEFT(RIGHT(ER_VAT_Number__c, 8), 6)), 89) != VALUE(RIGHT(ER_VAT_Number__c ,2)), FALSE)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: VRBE03 - Please enter the VAT number in the correct format.
